verses.raw: Say, "Do you indeed disbelieve in He who created the earth in two days and attribute to Him equals? That is the Lord of the worlds."
verses.text: Say, "Do you indeed disbelieve in He who created the earth in two days and attribute to Him equals? That is the Lord of the worlds."

verses.raw: And He placed on it [i.e., the earth] firmly set mountains over its surface, and He blessed it and determined therein its [creatures'] sustenance in four days without distinction<sup foot_note=256409>1</sup> - for [the information of] those who ask.
verses.text: And He placed on it [i.e., the earth] firmly set mountains over its surface, and He blessed it and determined therein its [creatures'] sustenance in four days without distinction - for [the information of] those who ask.

verses.raw: Then He directed Himself<sup foot_note=256410>1</sup> to the heaven while it was smoke and said to it and to the earth, "Come [into being],<sup foot_note=256413>2</sup> willingly or by compulsion." They said, "We have come willingly."
verses.text: Then He directed Himself to the heaven while it was smoke and said to it and to the earth, "Come [into being], willingly or by compulsion." They said, "We have come willingly."

verses.raw: And He completed them as seven heavens within two days and inspired [i.e., made known] in each heaven its command. And We adorned the nearest heaven with lamps [i.e., stars, for beauty] and as protection.<sup foot_note=256414>1</sup> That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
verses.text: And He completed them as seven heavens within two days and inspired [i.e., made known] in each heaven its command. And We adorned the nearest heaven with lamps [i.e., stars, for beauty] and as protection. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
